whole_machine_acceptance.mode: Exact packaged backend, automatic root and shipped home seeds, byte-copy of retained encrypted whole-footprint inventory after normal runtime upgrade; no selected-folder source or injected inventory rows.
whole_machine_acceptance.criterion_scope: Trial threshold for these small controlled versions and stale-path downgrades, including cold upgrade startup. Not a fleet SLO or bound for all backlog work.
whole_machine_acceptance.publication_measurement: Committed inventory/finding observations after each complete host tick. Setter hooks and fenced lookups are not publication or inspection proof.
whole_machine_acceptance.exclusions: Explicit current-user cloud, browser credential stores, live Password Buddy stores, test/staging roots, remote/volume aliases and mount boundaries. No extra permissions or hydration.
whole_machine_acceptance.scope: Bounded local Mac automatic coordinator trial; not exhaustive machine coverage, read-access monitoring or population recall.

aged_pending_execution.qualification: Committed complete results match source/generation/signature of pretrial pending versions, also present in an older encrypted pending snapshot; physical metadata rechecked. Selection route is not inferred. Wait lower bounds start after pretrial observation; no continuously pending age since the older snapshot or globally oldest queue bound is claimed.

pilot_readiness.assessment: Suitable for a limited single-user Mac alpha pilot under similar scope, backlog, exclusions and one-minute recurrence. Observed warm small-file completion reached 114 seconds; completed older backlog versions had wait lower bounds up to 476 seconds and the full backlog remains incomplete. Unattended corporate/fleet readiness and any fixed latency guarantee remain unqualified.

private_continuity_replay.qualification: Device-only metadata differences admitted only with matching content digests and current source fences; historical version gaps retained. Continuity, not population recall.

isolated_profile_continuity.qualification: Exact packaged bootstrap migration and direct backend continuity; earlier native GUI evidence remains separate. No material UI change in this branch.

privacy.scope: Final task files, uncompressed ZIP/wheel/TAR entries and all outgoing Git objects since fetched main. Known real values reacquired only in memory; no raw needles persisted or private inputs transferred.
